title: FAQ
description: Answers to common questions about Advice4you: what we do, cost, languages, privacy and immigration advice.
content:
FAQ

Questions and answers.

Short, honest answers. If your question is not here, send us a message.

What does Advice4you do?

We help newcomers with the practical side of life in the UK: benefits, the council, the NHS, letters, forms and phone calls. We explain things in simple words and help you take the next step.

Do you give immigration advice?

No. In the UK only regulated advisers and solicitors can give immigration advice. We can help you find one and help you get your papers ready for the meeting.

Are you a law firm?

No. Advice4you is not a law firm and we are not solicitors. If your problem needs a lawyer, we will tell you and help you find the right one.

Which languages can I use?

This website is in English, Bulgarian, Romanian, Turkish and Kurdish (Kurmanji and Sorani). When you contact us, tell us which language you speak and we will tell you how we can help.

How much does it cost?

Contacting us is free. Before we start any paid work, we tell you the price and what it includes. There are no hidden costs.

How do I book?

Send us a message on WhatsApp, call us or send an email. Tell us your name, your language and a few words about the problem.

Where do we meet?

We are based in Norwich and help people across Norfolk. When you contact us, we agree together how and where to meet.

What should I bring?

The letters or emails you received, your ID, any reference numbers, and a short list of your questions.

Is my information private?

Yes. We only use your information to help you. We do not share it without your permission, unless the law requires it. Please read our privacy policy for details.

Can you help me apply for Universal Credit?

Yes. We can explain how it works, help you set up your online account and help with the forms. The decision is always made by the Department for Work and Pensions, not by us.

Can you guarantee a result?

No. Decisions are made by the office that handles your case. What we promise is clear information and careful work.

I need a doctor. Can you help?

Yes. We can help you find a GP surgery near you and register. The NHS says you do not need ID, proof of address or proof of immigration status to register with a GP.

What if it is an emergency?

If a life is in danger, call 999. For urgent medical help that is not an emergency, call NHS 111. Advice4you is not an emergency service.

Do you help people outside Norwich?

Yes. We are based in Norwich and help people across Norfolk.

Still have a question?

Send us a short message. We will reply in simple words.
